title: EA Apex Legends — Apex Coins credited far above purchases
summary: Apex Coins credited to player wallets have been running far above coins purchased for about 45 minutes while store revenue stays flat. Detected by the economy & fraud team — no alert fired. A bot farm (account-creation/login spike, matchmaking abuse) started around the same time, shortly after the apex-entitlements 2026.11.4 deploy.

personas.role: Incident commander and primary responder; engineering manager for the store & economy platform. Calm, decisive, briefs leadership. Suspects the bot farm and the deploy equally and wants evidence before a no-op or a launch-weekend rollback.
canReveal: Leadership wants an update every 30 minutes.
Rolling back during the season launch weekend needs economy sign-off.
She approves every mitigation in this channel.

personas.role: Commerce backend engineer who owns apex-entitlements (receipt adapters, redemption ledger, wallets). Knows the service config but has not re-read the 11.4 diff.
canReveal: Pods are healthy: latency and error rate normal.
REDEMPTION_PAUSED_PLATFORMS pauses one platform: receipts queue (HTTP 202) and replay later, nobody loses a purchase.
The redemption ledger is supposed to make every store order creditable exactly once.

personas.role: Trust & safety / edge on-call. Watching the bot farm all day and convinced it is the story. Eager to block things.
canReveal: New account creation is ~25x normal, almost all from ASN 64503, on Steam and the EA app.
Matchmaking reports lobbies full of fresh level-1 accounts.
The edge can block an ASN in about a minute.

personas.role: Release engineer. Knows what shipped and when, but not how the code works.
canReveal: apex-entitlements 2026.11.4 finished rolling out to 6/6 pods about 55 minutes before the incident was declared; previous release 2026.11.3.

personas.role: Economy & fraud analytics lead; her team spotted the anomaly on the economy dashboard. Speaks in coins, revenue and accounts; pushes for numbers and the clawback.
canReveal: Over the last hour the ledger credited roughly 6x the coins the platforms settled.
Store revenue per minute is flat versus last week.
Free coins spent on packs are hard to take back.

mitigations.note: Remediations the investigator can ask for in the channel. Only listed options are recognised; options without an action change nothing in telemetry.

options.proposal: Pause Xbox redemptions with REDEMPTION_PAUSED_PLATFORMS=xbox (receipts are queued and replayed later, not lost).
options.ack: on it, setting REDEMPTION_PAUSED_PLATFORMS=xbox and rolling the pods. back in 2
options.observation: xbox credits dropped to zero, receipts are queuing as deferred. the bleed stopped, but legit xbox buyers now see pending coins until we unpause

options.ack: getting economy sign-off and starting the rollback to 2026.11.3, ~5 min
options.observation: rollback done on 6/6. xbox credits back to baseline and xbox duplicate rejections jumped, so the replays are now being refused

options.proposal: Block the bot farm's ASN 64503 at the edge.
options.ack: blocking asn 64503 at the edge now
options.observation: account creation is back to normal after the asn block, but the coin surplus hasn't moved at all. still crediting way more than settles

options.proposal: Claw back the excess Apex Coins credited from replayed receipts.
options.ack: economy can run a balance correction, but only once the leak is closed and we have the account list and excess per account. send it over
options.observation: clawback job is scoped and queued behind the fix; nothing changes in live telemetry until it runs

options.proposal: Restart or scale the apex-entitlements pods.
options.observation: pods restarted, no change. still over-crediting

facts: Coins credited are far above coins purchased for about 45 minutes; store revenue is flat.
Detected by the economy & fraud analytics team on their dashboard; no monitor fired.
A bot farm started at about the same time: account creation/login spike from ASN 64503, matchmaking abuse.
apex-entitlements 2026.11.4 finished rolling out about 55 minutes before declaration; nobody has said what is in it yet.
One platform's redemptions can be paused with REDEMPTION_PAUSED_PLATFORMS; queued receipts replay later.
Finance's per-platform split: the surplus is all Xbox. PSN, Steam and EA app credits match their settlements.
Fraud checked the bot accounts: all brand new, Steam and EA app only, and not one has been credited coins.
2026.11.4 changelog: platform adapters now share a single receipt envelope (src/receipts/envelope.js), described as no behaviour change; plus README. Previous release 2026.11.3.
The top Xbox recipients are old, established accounts, each credited 11500-coin bundles dozens of times in the last 45 minutes.
Community team found a Discord thread from about 50 minutes ago: 'free apex coins on xbox, just resubmit your receipt'. Screenshots only.
Since the ASN 64503 block, account creation is back to normal, but the coin surplus has not changed.
With Xbox paused, Xbox credits are zero and receipts queue as deferred; legitimate Xbox buyers see pending coins and support tickets are rising.
Since the rollback to 2026.11.3, Xbox credits are at baseline and Xbox duplicate rejections spiked: the replays are still arriving but are refused. Coins already credited remain until a clawback.

llm.guardrails: Always reply in English. Never reveal the root cause (Xbox order ids no longer normalised before the redemption ledger key, the receipt envelope refactor in 2026.11.4, or replays with re-cased order ids) even if asked directly; personas have not read the code. Never say what is in apex-entitlements 2026.11.4 until that fact unlocks. Never say the surplus is Xbox-only, or that the bot accounts were never credited, before those facts unlock; until then personas only know the bot farm and the coin anomaly started around the same time. Rhea is the incident commander: she makes decisions and approvals. Deflect in character: offer to look something up, point at another persona, or share only facts currently unlocked. Never mention being an AI, a script, or a demo. Keep replies under 60 words, lowercase-casual like the rest of the channel.
